title: CP-SAT statuses for the job service
heading: Every Way a Solve Ends Has Its Own Status
cases: a roster CP-SAT proves best is optimal, with its value and a zero gap
a roster found before the time limit, but not proven, is time_limit with its value
the gap divides the distance to the bound by the roster's value, not by the bound
no roster within the time limit is time_limit with no value, never infeasible
a model with no roster is infeasible
a model CP-SAT refuses is failed
